name: Path Integral Framework
aliases: Path Integral Formulation of the Rendering Equation
definition: A formulation of light transport simulation as a Monte Carlo integration problem over the space of light transport paths, serving as the basis for combining photon density estimation and Monte Carlo path integration.
summary: The Path Integral Framework formulates light transport as a continuous functional integral over path space, distinguishing itself from standard path tracing by enabling analytical approximations like WKB expansions for multiple scattering in participating media.
